title: proposal file, version 2 (layer-proposal/2): what a reviewed ontology hands to a host's semantic layer, links between records included
description: The file `latence_proposal_writer` writes (YAML; this schema is held against the file as read back). It is written from a host's description of the shape its own proposal tool reads, extended by two kinds of entry; the host's reader is the authority on that shape, and this schema describes only what this writer writes. Every entry names where it goes by a catalog object and a column, and carries the decision it rests on. Nothing else is written: no mark such as `seeded` or `certified_on` exists here, because what would carry one is never written. Version 2 states `format: layer-proposal/2` and adds one kind of entry, a link between two records a person approved, in the shape the host's tool reads (its ticket 294; this side's ticket 45). A file without `format` is version 1 and holds no link.

format.description: The file's version. Absent in version 1.

source.description: The kind of source the entries come from.

origin.description: The decision the entry rests on: the element decided (its id in the export), what it stated when it was decided (its claim), and who approved it on which day.

at.description: The day of the decision, an ISO date.

spellings_entry.description: Two values of a value set that a reviewer called the same: the value kept and its other spellings.

object.description: A catalog object that holds the value set, as `<schema>.<table>`.

value.description: The value kept: the one more rows carry.

names_entry.description: The names of a master list's records, by the record's key.

values.description: Key of a record -> its name.

origin_of_a_link.description: The decision the entry rests on: the element decided (its id in the export), what it stated when it was decided (its claim), and who approved it on which day.

at.description: The day of the decision, an ISO date.

certified_on.description: On what the link's certification rests; only a reviewer's labels are written.

record.description: A record of a catalog object, by the object, its key column and the record's key.

link_entry.description: A record of another source that a person decided is the master list's record: never a link the machine made alone, never one that holds a seeded record, never two records of one object.

evidence.description: The statement codes the person saw.
